name: workflows
description: List or inspect reusable prompt workflows stored as markdown files in workflows/ (and .cursor/workflows). Chain-aware: workflows flagged [chain] carry an embedded tool pipeline (frontmatter chain:) and the chain tool can execute them. Input: {} to list, {"name":"plan"} to show one, {"name":"plan","args":"feature"} to expand it into the full prompt, {"name":"plan","chain":""} to surface the embedded chain.
llm_description: List/inspect reusable prompt workflows (markdown files in workflows/ and .cursor/workflows). Workflows flagged [chain] carry an embedded tool pipeline (frontmatter chain:), runnable via the chain tool. Input: {} lists all; {name} shows one; {name, args} expands args into the prompt; {name, chain: ""} surfaces the embedded chain.

name.description: Workflow name (file stem of workflows/<name>.md). Omit to list all.

args.description: Arguments to substitute for {{args}} / $ARGUMENTS in the workflow body.

chain.description: When provided (any string), include the embedded chain pipeline from frontmatter chain: if present.
